name: civ6-savegame-parser
description: Reads the game state out of a Sid Meier's Civilization VI .Civ6Save file: map, cities, units, players, diplomacy, religion, eras, great works, fog of war — without the game.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/vendor && cp src/vendor/*.cjs dist/vendor/
